title: Two Auctions, Two Sets of Bids, One Revenue
summary: Run a first-price and a second-price auction on exactly the same bidders. The bids look nothing alike and the seller earns the same.

sources.title: Vickrey, Counterspeculation, Auctions, and Competitive Sealed Tenders, J. Finance 16(1), 1961
Myerson, Optimal Auction Design, Mathematics of Operations Research 6(1), 1981
